title: Notes
subtitle: Moments without a trip – a sunset, a thought, a flight that never became a trip.
loadError: The notes could not be loaded.

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.description: Keep a moment that belongs to no trip. Which trip a note fits is worked out later from its date, by itself.

editor.bodyRequired: Please write something in the note.
editor.timeHint: Leave empty when only the day matters.
editor.zoneHint: The time zone you are writing the note in. It decides which day the note belongs to – just after midnight in Berlin is still yesterday in London.
editor.placeHint: Optional. Stored as text only – if the place changes later, the note stays as it was.
editor.photoWillBeRemoved: The photo will be removed when you save.
editor.shareableHint: Unticked, the note stays private. Ticked, the companions of a shared trip on that day see it too, and a public trip link can show it when you choose “Notes” there.

delete.title: Delete note?
delete.body: The note from {{date}} will be deleted, along with its photo. This cannot be undone.

errors.saveFailed: The note could not be saved.
errors.deleteFailed: The note could not be deleted.
errors.zoneMissing: Without a time zone there is no telling which day the note belongs to. Please choose a time zone.
errors.photoFailed: The note is saved, but the photo is not.
errors.photoTooLarge: The photo is too large (15 MB at most). The note is saved, the photo is not.
errors.photoUnreadable: The photo could not be read. The note is saved, the photo is not.
errors.photoType: Only images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC) can go with a note. The note is saved, the photo is not.
errors.photoRemoveFailed: The note is saved, but the photo could not be removed.
errors.photoTooLargeLocal: The photo is too large (15 MB at most).
errors.photoTypeLocal: Only images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC) can go with a note.

paging.end_other: That's all – all {{count}} notes are loaded.
paging.failed: Older notes could not be loaded.
